question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a black ball, and Claire has a purple present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) black ball
(C) purple present

segments.text: Okay, so I'm trying to figure out who ends up with which gift after the swaps.
Let me break it down step by step.
First, the initial setup: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a black ball, and Claire has a purple present.
The first swap is between Bob and Claire.
So Bob gives his black ball to Claire, and Claire gives her purple present to Bob.
After this swap, Bob now has the purple present, and Claire has the black ball.
Alice still has the pink ball.
So Alice gives her pink ball to Claire, and Claire gives her black ball to Alice.
Now, Alice has the black ball, Claire has the pink ball, and Bob still has the purple present.
Claire gives her pink ball to Bob, and Bob gives his purple present to Claire.
So after this swap, Claire has the purple present, and Bob has the pink ball.
Alice still has the black ball.
Wait, but the question is asking what Claire has at the end.
So after all the swaps, Claire ends up with the purple present.
